about: A sign-in service you run yourself, so people log in to your apps with passkeys instead of passwords.

prs.title: One user without an email no longer stops the whole directory sync
prs.broken: The service copies users from the company directory. If even one of them, like a service account, had no email address, the whole copy failed and nobody was added or updated, on every run.
prs.changed: Users without an email are now skipped with a warning, and everyone else is copied.
prs.matters: One odd account can't keep everyone else from getting access.

prs.title: People removed from the directory now lose access in connected apps
prs.broken: When a person was removed from the company directory, the service turned off their account. But the apps kept in sync never heard, so the person stayed active there.
prs.changed: Turning off an account this way now marks it as changed, so the next sync sends it.
prs.matters: Someone who leaves loses access in the connected apps too, not only in the sign-in service.

prs.title: Long ID numbers now arrive with every digit intact
prs.broken: Admins can attach extra details to users, like a Discord ID. Long numbers came out with the last digits wrong, and 1000000 came out as "1e+06", which some apps rejected.
prs.changed: The sign-in service now keeps whole numbers exactly as they were saved.
prs.matters: Apps that rely on those details, for example to match a Discord account, get the right value.

prs.title: Removing someone from a group now reaches connected apps
prs.broken: When an admin removed a user from a group on the user's page, the apps kept in sync with the service were never told. The user stayed in that group there.
prs.changed: Saving a user's groups now marks the groups they left as changed too, so the next sync sends them.
prs.matters: When someone's access is taken away, it is taken away in the connected apps as well.

prs.title: Renewed API keys get their expiry reminder email again
prs.broken: The service emails a reminder before an API key expires. After a key was renewed it still counted as already reminded, so it never got another reminder.
prs.changed: Renewing a key now clears that mark, so the reminder goes out again before the new expiry date.
prs.matters: People are warned before a renewed key stops working.
